name: BidGoNoGoDecisionBoard
tagline: Decide which tenders to chase – weighted scorecard, knock-outs, estimating capacity and bonding headroom in one Power Apps component.
description: A complete bid / no-bid app for contractors: score every opportunity against weighted criteria, see the Go / Review / No-go recommendation, block knock-out risks, check estimating-team capacity per week and surety (bonding) headroom, and record who decided what and why – with executive approval for large bids. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Weighted 1–5 scorecard with configurable criteria and thresholds
Knock-out risk flags with conditional override and approval
Derived win probability and weighted pipeline
Estimating load per week and per estimator
Pipeline board with drag & drop and stage rules
Decision record and pipeline summary texts
Bulk assign, hold, notes, CSV export, undo
Demo mode, map-your-columns, read-only and disabled states
Desktop, tablet and phone layouts; keyboard and screen reader support
